nodes.text: and gave me sweet comfort. Then she passed away
thus, in grace.
One was called Sister Adelheid of Rode;
she was a widow and brought a
little daughter with her into the convent, who was called
Irmelin. With the child our Lord began
at once, and worked the greatest
wonders with her. One day, when
she was sitting with other children at table
on a fast-day, when she was about twelve years
old, the children's mistress had gone away from
them. Then the other children began to talk;
then she fell down and fainted.
When she came to herself again,
they asked her what had been the matter with her.
Then she said: Alas, children, you ought to keep silent
at table. I have seen such a
horrible devil; he has all your words
written down, and because of that I have
fainted. And whenever she was in her
bed, she was as inwardly ardent as
